# Executive Summary {.tabset}

This analysis examines Bitcoin's evolving connectedness with traditional financial assets using **TVP-VAR Frequency Connectedness**. Key analyses include:

- **Regime Detection**: PELT algorithm on Total Connectedness Index
- **Hypothesis Testing**: ETF impact, role evolution, safe-haven properties
- **Portfolio Hedging**: Out-of-sample rolling window with transaction costs
- **DCC-GARCH Benchmark**: Model comparison
- **Bootstrap Inference**: Confidence intervals for key metrics

---

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions}
# Statistical Helper Functions
theme_jbf_paper <- function(base_size = 12, base_family = "") {
  theme_jbf(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) %+replace%
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_blank()
    )
}

#' ADF Test Batch Processing
adf_test_batch <- function(data, lag_order = NULL) {
  require(tseries)

  numeric_cols <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

  if (is.null(lag_order)) {
    lag_order <- floor(12 * (nrow(data)/100)^0.25)
  }

  results <- map_dfr(numeric_cols, function(col) {
    tryCatch({
      test <- adf.test(na.omit(data[[col]]), k = min(lag_order, floor(nrow(data)/3)))
      tibble(
        Variable = col,
        ADF_Stat = round(test$statistic, 4),
        P_Value = round(test$p.value, 4),
        Lag = test$parameter,
        Stationary = ifelse(test$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      tibble(Variable = col, ADF_Stat = NA, P_Value = NA, Lag = NA, Stationary = "Error")
    })
  })

  return(results)
}

#' Calculate Regime Statistics
calc_regime_stats <- function(df, value_col, date_col, regime_bounds, regime_names) {
  n_regimes <- length(regime_bounds) - 1

  map_dfr(1:n_regimes, function(i) {
    mask <- df[[date_col]] >= regime_bounds[i] & df[[date_col]] <= regime_bounds[i + 1]
    vals <- df[[value_col]][mask]

    tibble(
      Regime = regime_names[i],
      Start = regime_bounds[i],
      End = regime_bounds[i + 1],
      N = sum(!is.na(vals)),
      Mean = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      Skewness = moments::skewness(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      Kurtosis = moments::kurtosis(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
}

# Hedging Helper Functions (Kroner & Sultan 1993)

#' Optimal Hedge Ratio: β* = Cov(x,y) / Var(y)
compute_hedge_ratio <- function(cov_xy, var_y) {
  if (var_y == 0) return(NA)
  return(cov_xy / var_y)
}

#' Optimal Portfolio Weight: w* = (Var(y) - Cov(x,y)) / (Var(x) - 2*Cov(x,y) + Var(y))
compute_optimal_weight <- function(var_x, var_y, cov_xy, constrained = TRUE) {
  denom <- var_x - 2 * cov_xy + var_y
  if (abs(denom) < 1e-10) return(NA)

  w <- (var_y - cov_xy) / denom

  if (constrained) {
    w <- pmin(pmax(w, 0), 1)
  }
  return(w)
}

#' Hedging Effectiveness: HE = 1 - Var(hedged) / Var(unhedged)
compute_hedging_effectiveness <- function(r_hedged, r_unhedged) {
  var_unhedged <- var(r_unhedged, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (var_unhedged == 0) return(NA)
  return(1 - var(r_hedged, na.rm = TRUE) / var_unhedged)
}

# Portfolio Performance Metrics

compute_portfolio_metrics <- function(returns, rf = 0, freq = 252) {
  r <- returns[!is.na(returns)]
  n <- length(r)

  if (n < 2) {
    return(list(
      Ann_Return = NA, Ann_Volatility = NA, Sharpe = NA, Sortino = NA,
      MaxDrawdown = NA, Calmar = NA, VaR_95 = NA, ES_95 = NA, N = n
    ))
  }

  # Annualized metrics
  ann_return <- mean(r) * freq
  ann_vol <- sd(r) * sqrt(freq)
  sharpe <- ifelse(ann_vol > 0, (ann_return - rf) / ann_vol, NA)

  # Sortino ratio (downside deviation)
  downside <- r[r < 0]
  downside_dev <- if (length(downside) > 1) sd(downside) * sqrt(freq) else NA
  sortino <- ifelse(!is.na(downside_dev) && downside_dev > 0, ann_return / downside_dev, NA)

  # Maximum Drawdown
  cum_ret <- cumprod(1 + r)
  running_max <- cummax(cum_ret)
  drawdown <- (running_max - cum_ret) / running_max
  max_dd <- max(drawdown, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Calmar Ratio
  calmar <- ifelse(max_dd > 0, ann_return / max_dd, NA)

  # VaR and ES (95%)
  var_95 <- quantile(r, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  es_95 <- mean(r[r <= var_95], na.rm = TRUE)

  return(list(
    Ann_Return = ann_return,
    Ann_Volatility = ann_vol,
    Sharpe = sharpe,
    Sortino = sortino,
    MaxDrawdown = max_dd,
    Calmar = calmar,
    VaR_95 = var_95,
    ES_95 = es_95,
    N = n
  ))
}

# Ledoit-Wolf Bootstrap Test for Sharpe Ratio

ledoit_wolf_test <- function(r1, r2, B = 1000, alpha = 0.05) {
  # Remove NAs and align
  valid_idx <- !is.na(r1) & !is.na(r2)
  r1 <- r1[valid_idx]
  r2 <- r2[valid_idx]
  n <- length(r1)

  if (n < 30) {
    return(list(
      Sharpe_1 = NA, Sharpe_2 = NA, Difference = NA, SE = NA,
      t_stat = NA, p_value = NA, CI_lower = NA, CI_upper = NA, Significant = NA
    ))
  }

  # Original Sharpe ratios
  sharpe1 <- mean(r1) / sd(r1)
  sharpe2 <- mean(r2) / sd(r2)
  delta_orig <- sharpe1 - sharpe2

  # Block bootstrap (Politis & Romano)
  block_size <- ceiling(n^(1/3))
  boot_deltas <- numeric(B)

  for (b in 1:B) {
    # Generate block bootstrap sample
    n_blocks <- ceiling(n / block_size)
    start_idx <- sample(1:(n - block_size + 1), n_blocks, replace = TRUE)
    boot_idx <- unlist(lapply(start_idx, function(s) s:min(s + block_size - 1, n)))
    boot_idx <- boot_idx[1:n]

    r1_boot <- r1[boot_idx]
    r2_boot <- r2[boot_idx]

    s1 <- mean(r1_boot) / sd(r1_boot)
    s2 <- mean(r2_boot) / sd(r2_boot)
    boot_deltas[b] <- s1 - s2
  }

  # Statistics
  se_boot <- sd(boot_deltas, na.rm = TRUE)
  t_stat <- delta_orig / se_boot

  # Two-tailed studentized test of H0: equal Sharpe ratios (difference = 0),
  # using the block-bootstrap standard error.
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(t_stat)))

  # Confidence interval
  ci_lower <- quantile(boot_deltas, alpha / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ci_upper <- quantile(boot_deltas, 1 - alpha / 2, na.rm = TRUE)

  return(list(
    Sharpe_1 = sharpe1,
    Sharpe_2 = sharpe2,
    Difference = delta_orig,
    SE = se_boot,
    t_stat = t_stat,
    p_value = p_value,
    CI_lower = ci_lower,
    CI_upper = ci_upper,
    Significant = p_value < alpha
  ))
}

# Bootstrap CI for TCI

bootstrap_tci_ci <- function(data_zoo, B = 200, alpha = 0.05, kappa = 0.99,
                              nlag = 1, partition = c(pi + 0.00001, pi/5, 0),
                              block_size = 20) {

  n <- nrow(data_zoo)
  tci_boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = B, ncol = 3)
  colnames(tci_boot) <- c("Total", "Short_term", "Long_term")

  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "  Bootstrap [:bar] :percent eta: :eta",
    total = B, clear = FALSE, width = 60
  )

  for (b in 1:B) {
    pb$tick()

    # Block bootstrap
    n_blocks <- ceiling(n / block_size)
    start_idx <- sample(1:(n - block_size + 1), n_blocks, replace = TRUE)
    boot_idx <- unlist(lapply(start_idx, function(s) s:min(s + block_size - 1, n)))
    boot_idx <- boot_idx[boot_idx <= n][1:n]

    data_boot_raw <- data_zoo[boot_idx, ]
    data_boot <- zoo(coredata(data_boot_raw), order.by = 1:nrow(data_boot_raw))

    tryCatch({
      dca_boot <- ConnectednessApproach(
        data_boot,
        model = "TVP-VAR",
        connectedness = "Frequency",
        nlag = nlag,
        VAR_config = list(TVPVAR = list(kappa1 = kappa, kappa2 = kappa, prior = "BayesPrior")),
        Connectedness_config = list(
          FrequencyConnectedness = list(partition = partition, generalized = TRUE, scenario = "ABS")
        )
      )
      tci_boot[b, ] <- colMeans(dca_boot$TCI, na.rm = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      tci_boot[b, ] <- NA
    })
  }

  # Calculate CIs
  valid_boot <- tci_boot[complete.cases(tci_boot), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(valid_boot) < 10) {
    warning("Less than 10 successful bootstrap replications")
    return(NULL)
  }

  ci_results <- tibble(
    Band = c("Total", "Short-term", "Long-term"),
    Mean = colMeans(valid_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = apply(valid_boot, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_Lower = apply(valid_boot, 2, quantile, probs = alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_Upper = apply(valid_boot, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  return(list(
    ci = ci_results,
    boot_samples = valid_boot,
    n_success = nrow(valid_boot),
    n_total = B
  ))
}

# Pretty Table Function

pretty_table <- function(df, title = NULL, digits = 3) {
  df %>%
    kbl(caption = title, digits = digits, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "center"

}
```

```{r data_loading}
# Load Data

# Mendeley deposit layout: this script lives in code/ and the data in data/.
# When knit from the code/ folder, the data is reached at ../data/market_data.csv;
# if a copy of market_data.csv is placed in the working directory, that is used instead.

if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  stop(glue("

    Please ensure 'market_data.csv' is in your working directory.

  "))
}

data_raw <- read.csv(data_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Raw data loaded\n")
cat("   Dimensions:", nrow(data_raw), "rows ×", ncol(data_raw), "columns\n")
```

## Data Cleaning and Transformation

```{r data_cleaning}
# Data Cleaning

# Parse dates and sort
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date))

# Remove rows with all NA values
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  filter(rowSums(is.na(select(., -Date))) < (ncol(.) - 1))

cat("Data cleaned\n")
cat("   Observations:", nrow(clean_data), "\n")
cat("   Period:", as.character(min(clean_data$Date)), "to", as.character(max(clean_data$Date)), "\n")

# Variable Classification

# Core model (Parsimonious - 4 variables)
core_vars <- c("BTC", "SPY", "XAU.USD", "VIX")

# Extended model (6 variables)
extended_vars <- c("BTC", "SPY", "XAU.USD", "VIX", "TNX", "IYR")

# Check available variables
available_core <- intersect(core_vars, names(clean_data))
available_extended <- intersect(extended_vars, names(clean_data))

cat("\nVariable availability:\n")
cat("   Core variables:", paste(available_core, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("   Extended variables:", paste(available_extended, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Price variables (log returns)
price_vars <- intersect(
  c("BTC", "SPY", "DJI", "IXIC", "NYSE", "XAU.USD", "IYR", "VNQ"),
  names(clean_data)
)

# Level/indicator variables (first difference)
level_vars <- intersect(
  c("VIX", "TNX", "GreedIndex"),
  names(clean_data)
)

# Network variables (log returns)
network_vars <- intersect(
  c("HashDiff", "Hashrate", "Address", "Transaction"),
  names(clean_data)
)

# Returns Transformation

returns_data <- clean_data %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    # Price variables → Log returns
    across(all_of(price_vars), ~ c(NA, diff(log(.))), .names = "{.col}"),
    # Level variables → First difference
    across(all_of(level_vars), ~ c(NA, diff(.)), .names = "{.col}"),
    # Network variables → Log returns
    across(all_of(network_vars), ~ c(NA, diff(log(.))), .names = "{.col}")
  ) %>%
  slice(-1)

# Store original prices for later use
prices_data <- clean_data

# Handle infinite values from log(0)
returns_data <- returns_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.), NA, .)))

# Remove rows with too many NAs in core variables
returns_data <- returns_data %>%
  filter(rowSums(is.na(select(., all_of(available_core)))) == 0)

cat("\nReturns calculated\n")
cat("   Final observations:", nrow(returns_data), "\n")

# Create Zoo Objects

# Core model zoo
core_data_zoo <- zoo(
  returns_data[, available_core],
  order.by = returns_data$Date
)

# Extended model zoo (if available)
if (length(available_extended) == length(extended_vars)) {
  extended_data_zoo <- zoo(
    returns_data[, available_extended],
    order.by = returns_data$Date
  )
} else {
  extended_data_zoo <- core_data_zoo
}

cat("Zoo objects created\n")
cat("   Core model:", ncol(core_data_zoo), "variables,", nrow(core_data_zoo), "observations\n")
```

```{r summary_stats}
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Return") %>%
  # BTC, SPY and Gold are log returns, reported in percent; VIX enters as a
  # first difference in index points and stays on its own scale.
  mutate(Return = ifelse(Variable %in% c("BTC", "SPY", "XAU.USD"), Return * 100, Return)) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(Return)),
    Mean = mean(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    Skewness = moments::skewness(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    Kurtosis = moments::kurtosis(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    JB_Stat = tseries::jarque.bera.test(na.omit(Return))$statistic,
    JB_Pval = tseries::jarque.bera.test(na.omit(Return))$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = available_core),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Variable)

# Display table
summary_stats %>%
  pretty_table(title = "Table 1: Descriptive Statistics of Daily Returns (%)")

# Save
write.csv(summary_stats, "Table1_Descriptive_Statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Regime Detection

## PELT Algorithm on TCI

```{r regime_detection}
# Preliminary TVP-VAR for TCI-based Regime Detection

cat("Running preliminary TVP-VAR estimation...\n")

# Frequency partition: Short-term (1-5 days), Long-term (>5 days)
partition_freq <- c(pi + 0.00001, pi/5, 0)

dca_preliminary <- ConnectednessApproach(
  core_data_zoo,
  model = "TVP-VAR",
  connectedness = "Frequency",
  nlag = 1,
  nfore = 10,
  VAR_config = list(
    TVPVAR = list(kappa1 = 0.99, kappa2 = 0.99, prior = "BayesPrior")
  ),
  Connectedness_config = list(
    FrequencyConnectedness = list(
      partition = partition_freq,
      generalized = TRUE,
      scenario = "ABS"
    )
  )
)

cat("Preliminary estimation complete\n")

# Extract TCI
tci_df <- as.data.frame(dca_preliminary$TCI)
tci_df$Date <- as.Date(rownames(tci_df))
colnames(tci_df)[1:3] <- c("Total", "Short_term", "Long_term")

tci_total <- tci_df$Total
tci_dates <- tci_df$Date
# HYBRID REGIME DEFINITION

cat("Applying Hybrid Regime Detection...\n\n")

# STEP 1: Event-Based Regime (MAIN)

event_definitions <- tribble(
  ~Event,              ~Date,
  "COVID Crash",       "2020-03-12",
  "BTC ATH/Fed Signal", "2021-11-10",
  "FTX Collapse",      "2022-11-08",
  "Spot ETF Approval", "2024-01-10"
) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

# 데이터 범위 내 이벤트만 필터링
valid_events <- event_definitions %>%
  filter(Date >= min(tci_dates) & Date <= max(tci_dates))

cat("Event-Based Boundaries (Main Analysis):\n")
print(valid_events)

# Main regime bounds 생성
regime_bounds <- sort(unique(c(
  min(tci_dates),
  valid_events$Date,
  max(tci_dates)
)))

n_regimes <- length(regime_bounds) - 1

# Regime 이름 (경제적 의미 부여)
regime_labels <- c(
  "Pre-COVID",
  "COVID Recovery",
  "Bull Market",
  "Bear Market",
  "Post-ETF"
)
regime_names <- regime_labels[1:n_regimes]
# [FIX] Update Regime Colors dynamically based on defined names
# 확정된 Regime 이름에 색상을 매핑합니다.
if(length(regime_names) <= length(palette_regime_hex)) {
  colors_regime <- setNames(palette_regime_hex[1:length(regime_names)], regime_names)
} else {
  # Regime이 예상보다 많을 경우를 대비해 색상 확장
  colors_regime <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(regime_names)), regime_names)
}

# Custom scale functions update (colors_regime이 갱신된 후 다시 정의)
scale_color_regime <- function(...) {
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_regime, ...)
}

scale_fill_regime <- function(...) {
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_regime, ...)
}

# 자산 색상도 데이터에 있는 것만 안전하게 매칭 (NA 방지)
scale_color_jbf <- function(...) {
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_extended, na.value = "gray50", ...)
}

scale_fill_jbf <- function(...) {
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_extended, na.value = "gray50", ...)
}

# STEP 4: Final Regime Info Table

regime_info <- tibble(
  Regime = regime_names,
  Start = regime_bounds[1:n_regimes],
  End = regime_bounds[2:(n_regimes + 1)],
  Days = as.numeric(difftime(regime_bounds[2:(n_regimes + 1)],
                              regime_bounds[1:n_regimes], units = "days"))
) %>%
  mutate(
    Duration_Pct = round(Days / sum(Days) * 100, 1),
    Key_Event = c(NA, valid_events$Event)[1:n_regimes]
  )

regime_info %>%
  pretty_table(title = "Table 3: Regime Definition (Event-Based with PELT Validation)")

cat("Colors synchronized with Regime names:", paste(names(colors_regime), collapse=", "), "\n")

cat("TCI extracted:", length(tci_total), "observations\n")
cat("   TCI range:", round(min(tci_total, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "-",
    round(max(tci_total, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "\n")
```
```{r pelt_detection}
# HYBRID REGIME DEFINITION

cat("Applying Hybrid Regime Detection...\n\n")

# STEP 1: Event-Based Regime (MAIN)

event_definitions <- tribble(
  ~Event,              ~Date,
  "COVID Crash",       "2020-03-12",
  "BTC ATH/Fed Signal", "2021-11-10",
  "FTX Collapse",      "2022-11-08",
  "Spot ETF Approval", "2024-01-10"
) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

# 데이터 범위 내 이벤트만 필터링
valid_events <- event_definitions %>%
  filter(Date >= min(tci_dates) & Date <= max(tci_dates))

cat("Event-Based Boundaries (Main Analysis):\n")
print(valid_events)

# Main regime bounds 생성
regime_bounds <- sort(unique(c(
  min(tci_dates),
  valid_events$Date,
  max(tci_dates)
)))

n_regimes <- length(regime_bounds) - 1

# Regime 이름 (경제적 의미 부여)
regime_labels <- c(
  "Pre-COVID",
  "COVID Recovery",
  "Bull Market",
  "Bear Market",
  "Post-ETF"
)
regime_names <- regime_labels[1:n_regimes]

# STEP 2: PELT Robustness Check

cat("\nRunning PELT for Robustness Check...\n")

# Conservative PELT settings
n_obs_tci <- length(tci_total)
conservative_penalty <- log(n_obs_tci) * 3  # BIC의 3배

cpt_robust <- cpt.meanvar(

  tci_total,
  method = "PELT",
  penalty = "Manual",
  pen.value = conservative_penalty,
  minseglen = 200  # 최소 ~10개월
)

pelt_changepoints <- cpts(cpt_robust)
pelt_dates <- if(length(pelt_changepoints) > 0) tci_dates[pelt_changepoints] else as.Date(character(0))

cat("   PELT changepoints found:", length(pelt_dates), "\n")
if(length(pelt_dates) > 0) {
  cat("   Dates:", as.character(pelt_dates), "\n")
}

# STEP 3: Event vs PELT 비교

if(length(pelt_dates) > 0 && nrow(valid_events) > 0) {

  event_pelt_comparison <- valid_events %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      Nearest_PELT = {
        distances <- abs(as.numeric(pelt_dates - Date))
        if(length(distances) > 0) as.character(pelt_dates[which.min(distances)]) else NA_character_
      },
      Distance_Days = {
        distances <- abs(as.numeric(pelt_dates - Date))
        if(length(distances) > 0) min(distances) else NA_real_
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  cat("\nEvent vs PELT Comparison:\n")
  print(event_pelt_comparison)

  avg_distance <- mean(event_pelt_comparison$Distance_Days, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\n   Average distance:", round(avg_distance, 1), "days\n")

  # 저장
  write.csv(event_pelt_comparison, "Table3b_Event_PELT_Comparison.csv", row.names = FALSE)

} else {
  cat("\nCannot compare: insufficient PELT changepoints or events\n")
  event_pelt_comparison <- NULL
}

# STEP 4: Final Regime Info Table

regime_info <- tibble(
  Regime = regime_names,
  Start = regime_bounds[1:n_regimes],
  End = regime_bounds[2:(n_regimes + 1)],
  Days = as.numeric(difftime(regime_bounds[2:(n_regimes + 1)],
                              regime_bounds[1:n_regimes], units = "days"))
) %>%
  mutate(
    Duration_Pct = round(Days / sum(Days) * 100, 1),
    Key_Event = c(NA, valid_events$Event)[1:n_regimes]
  )

regime_info %>%
  pretty_table(title = "Table 3: Regime Definition (Event-Based with PELT Validation)")

write.csv(regime_info, "Table3_Regime_Info.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# STEP 5: Add Regime Labels to Data

returns_data <- returns_data %>%
  mutate(
    Regime = cut(
      Date,
      breaks = regime_bounds,
      labels = regime_names,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

tci_df <- tci_df %>%
  mutate(
    Regime = cut(
      Date,
      breaks = regime_bounds,
      labels = regime_names,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

cat("\nHybrid regime detection complete\n")
cat("   Main approach: Event-Based (", n_regimes, " regimes)\n")
cat("   Robustness: PELT (", length(pelt_dates), " changepoints)\n")
```

# TVP-VAR Frequency Connectedness

## Core Model Estimation

```{r tvpvar_core}
# Full TVP-VAR Estimation (Core Model)

cat("Running full TVP-VAR estimation...\n")
cat("   Variables:", paste(available_core, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("   Observations:", nrow(core_data_zoo), "\n")

dca_core <- ConnectednessApproach(
  core_data_zoo,
  model = "TVP-VAR",
  connectedness = "Frequency",
  nlag = 1,
  nfore = 20,
  VAR_config = list(
    TVPVAR = list(
      kappa1 = 0.99,
      kappa2 = 0.99,
      prior = "BayesPrior"
    )
  ),
  Connectedness_config = list(
    FrequencyConnectedness = list(
      partition = partition_freq,
      generalized = TRUE,
      scenario = "ABS"
    )
  )
)

cat("TVP-VAR estimation complete\n")

# Extract and Process Results

# TCI
df_TCI <- as.data.frame(dca_core$TCI)
df_TCI$Date <- as.Date(rownames(df_TCI))
colnames(df_TCI)[1:3] <- c("Total", "Short_term", "Long_term")
df_TCI <- df_TCI %>%
  mutate(
    Regime = cut(Date, breaks = regime_bounds, labels = regime_names, include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

# NET
df_NET <- reshape2::melt(dca_core$NET)
names(df_NET) <- c("Date", "Asset", "Frequency_Band", "NET")
df_NET$Date <- as.Date(df_NET$Date)
df_NET <- df_NET %>%
  mutate(
    Frequency_Label = case_when(
      Frequency_Band == "1" ~ "Total",
      Frequency_Band == "2" ~ "Short-term",
      Frequency_Band == "3" ~ "Long-term",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Frequency_Band)
    ),
    Regime = cut(Date, breaks = regime_bounds, labels = regime_names, include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

# NPDC (Net Pairwise)
df_NPDC <- reshape2::melt(dca_core$NPDC)
names(df_NPDC) <- c("From", "To", "Date", "Frequency_Band", "NPDC")
df_NPDC$Date <- as.Date(df_NPDC$Date)
df_NPDC <- df_NPDC %>%
  mutate(
    Frequency_Label = case_when(
      Frequency_Band == "1" ~ "Total",
      Frequency_Band == "2" ~ "Short-term",
      Frequency_Band == "3" ~ "Long-term",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Frequency_Band)
    ),
    Regime = cut(Date, breaks = regime_bounds, labels = regime_names, include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

cat("Results extracted:\n")
cat("   TCI:", nrow(df_TCI), "observations\n")
cat("   NET:", nrow(df_NET), "observations\n")
cat("   NPDC:", nrow(df_NPDC), "observations\n")
```

```{r tci_analysis, fig.height=10}
# TCI Time Series Visualization (FIXED)

df_TCI_long <- df_TCI %>%

    cols = c(Total, Short_term, Long_term),
```

# Hypothesis Testing

## H1 & H2: ETF Impact Analysis

```{r etf_hypothesis}
# ETF Approval Impact Test (Robust HAC Approach)

etf_date <- as.Date("2024-01-10")

# Check if ETF date is in sample
if (etf_date >= min(df_TCI$Date) && etf_date <= max(df_TCI$Date)) {

  # 데이터 준비: 더미 변수 생성
  df_test <- df_TCI %>%
    mutate(
      Post_ETF_Dummy = ifelse(Date >= etf_date, 1, 0)
    )

  pre_etf <- df_test %>% filter(Post_ETF_Dummy == 0)
  post_etf <- df_test %>% filter(Post_ETF_Dummy == 1)

  cat("ETF Analysis Sample Sizes:\n")
  cat("   Pre-ETF:", nrow(pre_etf), "observations\n")
  cat("   Post-ETF:", nrow(post_etf), "observations\n\n")

  # [함수] HAC(Newey-West) Robust T-test 수행 함수
  run_robust_test <- function(y_col, alternative = "two.sided") {
    # 1. 회귀분석: Y = alpha + beta * Dummy
    formula <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Post_ETF_Dummy"))
    model <- lm(formula, data = df_test)

    # 2. Newey-West Standard Errors 계산 (시계열 자기상관 보정)
    # lag는 일반적으로 0.75 * T^(1/3) 등을 쓰거나 넉넉하게 잡음
    nw_vcov <- sandwich::NeweyWest(model, lag = floor(4 * (nrow(df_test)/100)^(2/9)), prewhite = FALSE, adjust = TRUE)

    # 3. 가설 검정
    test_res <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov = nw_vcov)

    beta <- test_res["Post_ETF_Dummy", "Estimate"]
    t_stat <- test_res["Post_ETF_Dummy", "t value"]
    p_val_two_sided <- test_res["Post_ETF_Dummy", "Pr(>|t|)"]

    # 단측 검정 P-value 변환
    if (alternative == "greater") {
      p_val <- ifelse(t_stat > 0, p_val_two_sided / 2, 1 - p_val_two_sided / 2)
    } else if (alternative == "less") {
      p_val <- ifelse(t_stat < 0, p_val_two_sided / 2, 1 - p_val_two_sided / 2)
    } else {
      p_val <- p_val_two_sided
    }

    return(list(stat = t_stat, p = p_val, diff = beta))
  }

  # 가설 검정 실행

  cat("Running Robust HAC Tests (Newey-West correction)...\n")

  # H1: Long-term increased (One-sided > 0)
  h1 <- run_robust_test("Long_term", alternative = "greater")

  # H2: Short-term decreased (One-sided < 0)
  h2 <- run_robust_test("Short_term", alternative = "less")

  # H3: Total changed (Two-sided)
  h3 <- run_robust_test("Total", alternative = "two.sided")

  # Summary table
  etf_test_results <- tibble(
    Hypothesis = c(
      "H1: Long-term TCI ↑ post-ETF",
      "H2: Short-term TCI ↓ post-ETF",
      "Total TCI change"
    ),
    Pre_ETF_Mean = c(
      mean(pre_etf$Long_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(pre_etf$Short_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(pre_etf$Total, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    Post_ETF_Mean = c(
      mean(post_etf$Long_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(post_etf$Short_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(post_etf$Total, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    Difference_Beta = c(h1$diff, h2$diff, h3$diff), # 회귀계수 beta가 곧 차이값
    Robust_t_stat = c(h1$stat, h2$stat, h3$stat),
    p_value = c(h1$p, h2$p, h3$p),
    Result = c(
      ifelse(h1$p < 0.05, "SUPPORTED ", "Not Supported"),
      ifelse(h2$p < 0.05, "SUPPORTED ", "Not Supported"),
      ifelse(h3$p < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant")
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

  # 출력
  etf_test_results %>%
    pretty_table(title = "Table 7: ETF Impact Hypothesis Tests (Robust HAC SE)")

  write.csv(etf_test_results, "Table7_ETF_Hypothesis_Tests.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nNote: Results based on regression with Newey-West HAC standard errors.\n")
  cat("   This corrects for autocorrelation in TVP-VAR connectedness series.\n")

} else {
  cat("ETF date is outside sample.\n")
}
```

## H3: Role Evolution (Receiver → Transmitter)

```{r role_evolution}
# H3: BTC Role Evolution (Receiver → Transmitter)

cat("H3: BTC Role Evolution Analysis\n\n")

# Method 1: Regime-Based Comparison

role_by_regime <- df_NET %>%
  filter(Asset == "BTC", Frequency_Label == "Total") %>%
  group_by(Regime) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_NET = mean(NET, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_NET = sd(NET, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Positive = mean(NET > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Binomial test: H0: P(NET > 0) = 0.5
    N_Positive = round(Pct_Positive / 100 * N),
    Binom_p = binom.test(N_Positive, N, p = 0.5)$p.value,
    Role = case_when(
      Pct_Positive > 50 & Binom_p < 0.05 ~ "Transmitter*",
      Pct_Positive < 50 & Binom_p < 0.05 ~ "Receiver*",
      Pct_Positive > 50 ~ "Transmitter",
      TRUE ~ "Receiver"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-N_Positive) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))

cat("Method 1: Regime-Based Analysis\n")
role_by_regime %>%
  pretty_table(title = "Table 8a: BTC Role by Regime (* = significant at 5%)")

# Method 2: Time Trend Analysis (Regime-Independent)

df_NET_BTC <- df_NET %>%
  filter(Asset == "BTC", Frequency_Label == "Total") %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    Time_Index = as.numeric(Date - min(Date)),
    Year = year(Date)
  )

# Kendall's tau test for monotonic trend
trend_test <- cor.test(
  df_NET_BTC$Time_Index,
  df_NET_BTC$NET,
  method = "kendall"
)

cat("\nMethod 2: Time Trend Analysis (Kendall's τ)\n")
cat("   τ =", round(trend_test$estimate, 4), "\n")
cat("   p-value =", format(trend_test$p.value, digits = 4), "\n")
cat("   Interpretation:",
    ifelse(trend_test$p.value < 0.05,
           ifelse(trend_test$estimate > 0,
                  "Significant POSITIVE trend (Receiver → Transmitter) ",
                  "Significant NEGATIVE trend"),
           "No significant trend"), "\n")

# Method 3: Rolling Window Analysis

window_size_roll <- 252  # 1 year

df_NET_BTC <- df_NET_BTC %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    Rolling_Mean_NET = zoo::rollapply(
      NET, width = window_size_roll, FUN = mean, fill = NA, align = "right"
    ),
    Rolling_Pct_Positive = zoo::rollapply(
      NET > 0, width = window_size_roll, FUN = mean, fill = NA, align = "right"
    ) * 100
  )

# Trend in rolling metrics
rolling_trend <- df_NET_BTC %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rolling_Mean_NET)) %>%
  summarise(
    Trend_Mean_NET = cor(Time_Index, Rolling_Mean_NET, method = "kendall"),
    Trend_Pct_Positive = cor(Time_Index, Rolling_Pct_Positive, method = "kendall")
  )

cat("\nMethod 3: Rolling Window Trend (252-day)\n")
cat("   Rolling Mean NET trend (τ):", round(rolling_trend$Trend_Mean_NET, 4), "\n")
cat("   Rolling % Positive trend (τ):", round(rolling_trend$Trend_Pct_Positive, 4), "\n")

# Method 4: Early vs Late Period Comparison

midpoint_date <- median(df_NET_BTC$Date)

early_late_comparison <- df_NET_BTC %>%
  mutate(Period = ifelse(Date < midpoint_date, "Early", "Late")) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_NET = mean(NET, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Positive = mean(NET > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    N = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test for difference
early_data <- df_NET_BTC %>% filter(Date < midpoint_date) %>% pull(NET)
late_data <- df_NET_BTC %>% filter(Date >= midpoint_date) %>% pull(NET)
period_ttest <- t.test(late_data, early_data, alternative = "greater")

cat("\nMethod 4: Early vs Late Period Comparison\n")
cat("   Midpoint:", as.character(midpoint_date), "\n")
cat("   Early period mean NET:", round(mean(early_data), 2), "\n")
cat("   Late period mean NET:", round(mean(late_data), 2), "\n")
cat("   t-test (Late > Early):\n")
cat("     t =", round(period_ttest$statistic, 3), "\n")
cat("     p =", format(period_ttest$p.value, digits = 4), "\n")

# Summary Table

h3_summary <- tibble(
  Method = c(
    "Regime Transition",
    "Kendall's τ (Time Trend)",
    "Rolling Mean NET Trend",
    "Early vs Late t-test"
  ),
  Test_Statistic = c(
    paste0(role_by_regime$Role[1], " → ", role_by_regime$Role[n_regimes]),
    round(trend_test$estimate, 4),
    round(rolling_trend$Trend_Mean_NET, 4),
    round(period_ttest$statistic, 3)
  ),
  P_Value = c(
    NA_character_,
    format(trend_test$p.value, digits = 4),
    NA_character_,
    format(period_ttest$p.value, digits = 4)
  ),
  Conclusion = c(
    ifelse(role_by_regime$Mean_NET[n_regimes] > role_by_regime$Mean_NET[1],
           "Supports H3", "Against H3"),
    ifelse(trend_test$p.value < 0.05 & trend_test$estimate > 0,
           "Supports H3 ", "Inconclusive"),
    ifelse(rolling_trend$Trend_Mean_NET > 0.1,
           "Supports H3", "Weak/No support"),
    ifelse(period_ttest$p.value < 0.05,
           "Supports H3 ", "Inconclusive")
  )
)

h3_summary %>%
  pretty_table(title = "Table 8b: H3 Evidence Summary (Multiple Methods)")

# Save results
write.csv(role_by_regime, "Table8a_BTC_Role_by_Regime.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(h3_summary, "Table8b_H3_Summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Visualization

# Rolling NET plot
p_rolling_net <- ggplot(df_NET_BTC, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = regime_shades,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Regime),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = NET), alpha = 0.4, color = "gray70") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Rolling_Mean_NET), color = colors_primary["primary"], linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Trend line
  geom_smooth(aes(y = NET), method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = colors_primary["danger"], fill = colors_primary["danger"], alpha=0.2, linetype = "dashed") +  scale_fill_regime() +
  labs(
    title = "BTC NET Connectedness: Role Evolution",
    subtitle = "Gray = Daily | Green = 252-day Rolling Mean | Red dashed = Linear Trend",
    x = "Date",
    y = "NET (%)"
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(p_rolling_net)
ggsave("Figure4b_BTC_Role_Evolution.png", p_rolling_net,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("\nH3 analysis complete\n")
```

# Threshold Regression: Conditional Safe-Haven

```{r threshold_regression, fig.height=10}
# Threshold Regression: Conditional Safe-Haven (FINAL FIXED)

# 1. 안전한 실행을 위한 데이터 및 변수 확인
if ("VIX" %in% names(prices_data) & "BTC" %in% unique(df_NPDC$From) & "SPY" %in% unique(df_NPDC$To)) {

  # [핵심] VIX 전용 색상 팔레트 정의 (데이터 이름과 100% 일치시킴)
  colors_vix <- c(
    "Low (<20)"        = "#27AE60", # Success Green
    "Moderate (20-30)" = "#F39C12", # Warning Orange
    "High (>30)"       = "#E74C3C"  # Danger Red
  )

  # VIX 데이터 준비
  vix_level <- prices_data %>%
    select(Date, VIX_Level = VIX)

  # BTC-SPY NPDC 데이터 병합
  btc_spy_npdc <- df_NPDC %>%
    filter(From == "BTC", To == "SPY", Frequency_Band == "Total") %>% # Total 밴드 사용
    left_join(vix_level, by = "Date") %>%
    filter(!is.na(VIX_Level)) %>%
    mutate(
      # 카테고리 생성 (확인된 데이터 이름 그대로 사용)
      VIX_Category = case_when(
        VIX_Level < 20 ~ "Low (<20)",
        VIX_Level >= 20 & VIX_Level < 30 ~ "Moderate (20-30)",
        VIX_Level >= 30 ~ "High (>30)"
      ),
      # 순서 고정 (Factor)
      VIX_Category = factor(VIX_Category, levels = c("Low (<20)", "Moderate (20-30)", "High (>30)"))
    )

  cat("Threshold analysis sample:", nrow(btc_spy_npdc), "observations\n")

  # 통계 및 회귀분석 (기존 로직 유지)

  # Statistics by VIX level
  safe_haven_stats <- btc_spy_npdc %>%
    group_by(VIX_Category) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean_NPDC = mean(NPDC, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_NPDC = sd(NPDC, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median_NPDC = median(NPDC, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Interpretation = case_when(
        Mean_NPDC < -1 ~ "Strong negative spillover",
        Mean_NPDC < 0 ~ "Weak negative spillover",
        Mean_NPDC < 1 ~ "Neutral/weak positive",
        TRUE ~ "Positive spillover"
      )
    )

  print(safe_haven_stats %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
          pretty_table(title = "Table 9: BTC→SPY NPDC by VIX Level"))

  # Threshold Regression Model
  threshold_model <- lm(
    NPDC ~ VIX_Level + I(VIX_Level > 30) + I(VIX_Level > 20),
    data = btc_spy_npdc
  )

  cat("\nThreshold Regression Results:\n")
  print(summary(threshold_model))

  # 시각화 (Visualization) - 색상 적용 수정

  # 1. Scatter Plot
  p_threshold_scatter <- ggplot(btc_spy_npdc, aes(x = VIX_Level, y = NPDC)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = VIX_Category), alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "#2C3E50", linewidth = 1.2, se = TRUE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(20, 30), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray40") +

    # 텍스트 라벨에도 색상 적용
    annotate("text", x = 10, y = max(btc_spy_npdc$NPDC) * 0.9, label = "Calm", fontface = "bold", color = colors_vix["Low (<20)"]) +
    annotate("text", x = 25, y = max(btc_spy_npdc$NPDC) * 0.9, label = "Moderate", fontface = "bold", color = colors_vix["Moderate (20-30)"]) +
    annotate("text", x = 40, y = max(btc_spy_npdc$NPDC) * 0.9, label = "Stress", fontface = "bold", color = colors_vix["High (>30)"]) +

    # [수정] colors_vix 적용
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_vix) +

    labs(
      title = "BTC→SPY NPDC vs VIX Level",
      subtitle = "Conditional Safe-Haven Analysis",
      x = "VIX Level",
      y = "NPDC (BTC → SPY)",
      color = "VIX Category"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  # 2. Box Plot
  p_threshold_box <- ggplot(btc_spy_npdc, aes(x = VIX_Category, y = NPDC, fill = VIX_Category)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 4, color = "white") +

    # [수정] colors_vix 적용
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_vix) +

    labs(
      title = "NPDC Distribution by VIX Level",
      x = "VIX Category",
      y = "NPDC (%)"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  # Combine
  p_threshold_combined <- p_threshold_scatter / p_threshold_box + plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1))

  print(p_threshold_combined)
  ggsave("Figure5_Threshold_SafeHaven.png", p_threshold_combined,
         width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

} else {
  cat("VIX data not available for threshold analysis\n")
}
```

# Portfolio Hedging Analysis

## Rolling Window Estimation

```{r portfolio_hedging}
# Out-of-Sample Portfolio Hedging

# Parameters
window_size <- 252  # 1 year rolling window
rebalance_freq <- "daily"

# Prepare data
hedge_data <- returns_data %>%
  select(Date, BTC, SPY) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BTC) & !is.na(SPY))

if ("XAU.USD" %in% names(returns_data)) {
  hedge_data <- hedge_data %>%
    left_join(returns_data %>% select(Date, Gold = XAU.USD), by = "Date")
}

n_obs <- nrow(hedge_data)
n_oos <- n_obs - window_size

cat("Portfolio Hedging Setup:\n")
cat("   Total observations:", n_obs, "\n")
cat("   Rolling window:", window_size, "days\n")
cat("   Out-of-sample period:", n_oos, "days\n\n")

if (n_oos < 50) {
  cat("Insufficient out-of-sample observations. Reducing window size.\n")
  window_size <- floor(n_obs * 0.6)
  n_oos <- n_obs - window_size
  cat("   Adjusted window:", window_size, "days\n")
  cat("   Adjusted OOS:", n_oos, "days\n")
}

# Rolling Estimation

cat("Computing rolling hedge ratios...\n")

hedge_results <- tibble(
  Date = hedge_data$Date[(window_size + 1):n_obs],
  BTC_ret = hedge_data$BTC[(window_size + 1):n_obs],
  SPY_ret = hedge_data$SPY[(window_size + 1):n_obs]
)

if ("Gold" %in% names(hedge_data)) {
  hedge_results$Gold_ret <- hedge_data$Gold[(window_size + 1):n_obs]
}

# Initialize columns
hedge_results$hedge_ratio_spy <- NA
hedge_results$opt_weight_spy <- NA

if ("Gold" %in% names(hedge_data)) {
  hedge_results$hedge_ratio_gold <- NA
  hedge_results$opt_weight_gold <- NA
}

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "  Rolling estimation [:bar] :percent",
  total = n_oos, clear = FALSE
)

for (t in 1:n_oos) {
  pb$tick()

  train_idx <- t:(t + window_size - 1)

  if ("Gold" %in% names(hedge_data)) {
    train_data <- hedge_data[train_idx, c("BTC", "SPY", "Gold")]
  } else {
    train_data <- hedge_data[train_idx, c("BTC", "SPY")]
  }

  cov_mat <- cov(train_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  # SPY hedge
  hedge_results$hedge_ratio_spy[t] <- compute_hedge_ratio(
    cov_mat["BTC", "SPY"], cov_mat["SPY", "SPY"]
  )
  hedge_results$opt_weight_spy[t] <- compute_optimal_weight(
    cov_mat["BTC", "BTC"], cov_mat["SPY", "SPY"], cov_mat["BTC", "SPY"]
  )

  # Gold hedge (if available)
  if ("Gold" %in% names(hedge_data)) {
    hedge_results$hedge_ratio_gold[t] <- compute_hedge_ratio(
      cov_mat["BTC", "Gold"], cov_mat["Gold", "Gold"]
    )
    hedge_results$opt_weight_gold[t] <- compute_optimal_weight(
      cov_mat["BTC", "BTC"], cov_mat["Gold", "Gold"], cov_mat["BTC", "Gold"]
    )
  }
}

cat("\nRolling estimation complete\n")

# Portfolio Returns

hedge_results <- hedge_results %>%
  mutate(
    # Unhedged BTC
    unhedged = BTC_ret,

    # Hedged with SPY: r_BTC - β * r_SPY
    hedged_spy = BTC_ret - lag(hedge_ratio_spy) * SPY_ret,

    # Optimal portfolio (BTC + SPY)
    optimal_spy = lag(opt_weight_spy) * BTC_ret + (1 - lag(opt_weight_spy)) * SPY_ret,

    # Static 60/40 BTC/SPY
    static_60_40 = 0.6 * BTC_ret + 0.4 * SPY_ret,

    # Equal weight
    equal_weight = 0.5 * BTC_ret + 0.5 * SPY_ret
  )

if ("Gold" %in% names(hedge_data)) {
  hedge_results <- hedge_results %>%
    mutate(
      hedged_gold = BTC_ret - lag(hedge_ratio_gold) * Gold_ret,
      optimal_gold = lag(opt_weight_gold) * BTC_ret + (1 - lag(opt_weight_gold)) * Gold_ret
    )
}

# Remove NAs from lagged variables
hedge_results <- hedge_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(hedged_spy))
```

## Transaction Cost Analysis

```{r transaction_costs}
# Transaction Cost Adjustment

tc_levels <- c(0, 0.0010, 0.0025, 0.0050)  # 0, 10, 25, 50 bps

# Compute turnover
hedge_results <- hedge_results %>%
  mutate(
    turnover_spy = abs(hedge_ratio_spy - lag(hedge_ratio_spy)),
    turnover_spy = ifelse(is.na(turnover_spy), 0, turnover_spy)
  )

# Apply transaction costs
for (tc in tc_levels) {
  tc_label <- paste0("tc_", tc * 10000)
  hedge_results[[paste0("hedged_spy_", tc_label)]] <-
    hedge_results$hedged_spy - tc * hedge_results$turnover_spy
}

cat("Transaction cost adjustments applied\n")
```

## Ledoit-Wolf Test

```{r ledoit_wolf}
# Ledoit-Wolf Test: Dynamic vs Static

cat("Ledoit-Wolf Bootstrap Test\n\n")

# Test 1: Optimal dynamic vs Static 60/40
lw_test1 <- ledoit_wolf_test(
  hedge_results$optimal_spy,
  hedge_results$static_60_40,
  B = 10000
)

cat("Dynamic Optimal vs Static 60/40:\n")
cat("  Dynamic Sharpe:", round(lw_test1$Sharpe_1 * sqrt(252), 3), "\n")
cat("  Static Sharpe:", round(lw_test1$Sharpe_2 * sqrt(252), 3), "\n")
cat("  Difference:", round(lw_test1$Difference * sqrt(252), 3), "\n")
cat("  p-value:", round(lw_test1$p_value, 4), "\n")
cat("  Result:", ifelse(lw_test1$Significant, "SIGNIFICANT", "Not Significant"), "\n\n")

# Test 2: Hedged vs Unhedged
lw_test2 <- ledoit_wolf_test(
  hedge_results$hedged_spy,
  hedge_results$unhedged,
  B = 10000
)

cat("Hedged (SPY) vs Unhedged BTC:\n")
cat("  Hedged Sharpe:", round(lw_test2$Sharpe_1 * sqrt(252), 3), "\n")
cat("  Unhedged Sharpe:", round(lw_test2$Sharpe_2 * sqrt(252), 3), "\n")
cat("  p-value:", round(lw_test2$p_value, 4), "\n")

# Summary table
lw_summary <- tibble(
  Comparison = c("Dynamic vs Static 60/40", "Hedged vs Unhedged"),
  Sharpe_1 = c(lw_test1$Sharpe_1, lw_test2$Sharpe_1) * sqrt(252),
  Sharpe_2 = c(lw_test1$Sharpe_2, lw_test2$Sharpe_2) * sqrt(252),
  Difference = c(lw_test1$Difference, lw_test2$Difference) * sqrt(252),
  SE = c(lw_test1$SE, lw_test2$SE) * sqrt(252),
  p_value = c(lw_test1$p_value, lw_test2$p_value),
  Significant = c(lw_test1$Significant, lw_test2$Significant)
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

lw_summary %>%
  pretty_table(title = "Table 13: Ledoit-Wolf Bootstrap Test Results")

write.csv(lw_summary, "Table13_LedoitWolf_Tests.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# DCC-GARCH Benchmark

```{r dcc_garch}
# DCC-GARCH Model Estimation & Comparison

cat("Estimating DCC-GARCH model...\n")

# 1. 데이터 준비
dcc_data <- returns_data %>%
  select(all_of(available_core)) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  as.matrix()

tryCatch({
  # 2. 모델 명세 (GARCH Specification)
  # Univariate GARCH: ARMA(1,0) + sGARCH(1,1) + Student-t distribution
  uspec <- ugarchspec(
    mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(1, 0)),
    variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
    distribution.model = "std"
  )

  # Multivariate DCC Specification
  mspec <- multispec(replicate(ncol(dcc_data), uspec))
  dccspec <- dccspec(
    uspec = mspec,
    dccOrder = c(1, 1),
    distribution = "mvt" # Multivariate Student-t
  )

  # 3. 모델 적합 (Fit)
  dcc_fit <- dccfit(dccspec, data = dcc_data, fit.control = list(eval.se = FALSE))
  cat("DCC-GARCH estimation complete\n")

  # 4. 결과 추출: 동적 상관계수 (Dynamic Correlation)
  dcc_cor <- rcor(dcc_fit)
  n_dcc <- dim(dcc_cor)[3]

  # BTC-SPY 상관계수 추출
  btc_spy_dcc <- sapply(1:n_dcc, function(t) dcc_cor["BTC", "SPY", t])

  dcc_results <- tibble(
    Date = returns_data$Date[1:n_dcc],
    BTC_SPY_DCC = btc_spy_dcc
  )

  # TVP-VAR 결과와 병합 (비교용 데이터)
  comparison_df <- dcc_results %>%
    left_join(
      df_NPDC %>%
        filter(From == "BTC", To == "SPY", Frequency_Band == "Total") %>%
        select(Date, NPDC_TVP = NPDC),
      by = "Date"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(NPDC_TVP))

  # 상관관계 계산
  cor_methods <- cor(comparison_df$BTC_SPY_DCC, comparison_df$NPDC_TVP / 100,
                     use = "complete.obs")

  cat("\nModel Comparison:\n")
  cat("   Correlation (DCC vs TVP-VAR):", round(cor_methods, 3), "\n")

  # 5. 결과 추출: 동적 헷지 비율 (Dynamic Hedge Ratio)
  dcc_cov <- rcov(dcc_fit)

  dcc_hedge_ratio <- sapply(1:n_dcc, function(t) {
    dcc_cov["BTC", "SPY", t] / dcc_cov["SPY", "SPY", t]
  })

  # 헷지 비율 비교 데이터 생성
  dcc_compare <- tibble(
    Date = returns_data$Date[1:n_dcc],
    hedge_ratio_dcc = dcc_hedge_ratio
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      hedge_results %>% select(Date, hedge_ratio_tvp = hedge_ratio_spy),
      by = "Date"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(hedge_ratio_tvp))

  # 비교 테이블 생성 및 출력
  model_comparison <- tibble(
    Model = c("TVP-VAR", "DCC-GARCH"),
    Mean_HR = c(mean(dcc_compare$hedge_ratio_tvp, na.rm = TRUE),
                mean(dcc_compare$hedge_ratio_dcc, na.rm = TRUE)),
    SD_HR = c(sd(dcc_compare$hedge_ratio_tvp, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd(dcc_compare$hedge_ratio_dcc, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Correlation = cor_methods
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

  print(model_comparison %>%
    pretty_table(title = "Table 15: TVP-VAR vs DCC-GARCH Comparison"))

  write.csv(model_comparison, "Table15_Model_Comparison.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  # 6. 시각화 (Visualization) - FINAL FIXED

  # (1) 데이터 구조 변환 (Wide -> Long)
  plot_dcc_long <- comparison_df %>%
    select(Date,
           `DCC-GARCH` = BTC_SPY_DCC,
           `TVP-VAR (Scaled)` = NPDC_TVP) %>%
    mutate(`TVP-VAR (Scaled)` = `TVP-VAR (Scaled)` / 100) %>% # 스케일 조정
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Date,
      names_to = "Model",
      values_to = "Value"
    )

  # (2) 색상 정의
  colors_models <- c(
    "DCC-GARCH"        = "#D4AF37", # Gold
    "TVP-VAR (Scaled)" = "#007B4B"  # Green
  )

  # (3) 그래프 그리기
  p_dcc_compare <- ggplot(plot_dcc_long, aes(x = Date, y = Value, color = Model)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +

    # 색상 적용
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_models) +

    labs(
      x = "Date",
      # Y축 라벨 줄바꿈 적용
      y = "Connectedness /\nCorrelation",
      color = "" # 범례 제목 제거
    ) +

    theme(
      # Y축 제목 세로 회전 (90도) 및 중앙 정렬
      axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  print(p_dcc_compare)
  ggsave("Figure7_DCC_Comparison.png", p_dcc_compare,
         width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

}, error = function(e) {
  cat("DCC-GARCH estimation failed:", e$message, "\n")
  cat("   Proceeding without DCC comparison.\n")
})
```

# Bootstrap Confidence Intervals

```{r bootstrap_ci, fig.height=10}
# Bootstrap CI for TCI

cat("Computing bootstrap confidence intervals...\n")
cat("   This may take several minutes...\n\n")

boot_tci <- bootstrap_tci_ci(
  core_data_zoo,
  B = 10000,  # Increase for final analysis
  alpha = 0.05,
  kappa = 0.99,
  nlag = 1,
  partition = partition_freq,
  block_size = 20
)

# Visualization: Bootstrap Distribution (FINAL FIXED)

if (!is.null(boot_tci)) {

  # 1. 부트스트랩 샘플 데이터 변환 (이름 매핑)
  boot_df <- as.data.frame(boot_tci$boot_samples) %>%
    # [핵심] 기존 컬럼명(Short_term 등)을 색상표의 키(Short-term (1-5d))로 변경
    dplyr::rename(
      `Total` = Total,
      `Short-term (1-5d)` = Short_term,
      `Long-term (>5d)` = Long_term
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Band", values_to = "TCI") %>%
    # 순서 고정
    mutate(Band = factor(Band, levels = c("Total", "Short-term (1-5d)", "Long-term (>5d)")))

  # 2. 신뢰구간(CI) 데이터 변환 (이름 매핑)
  ci_plot_data <- boot_tci$ci %>%
    mutate(
      Band = case_when(
        Band == "Total" ~ "Total",
        Band %in% c("Short-term", "Short_term") ~ "Short-term (1-5d)",
        Band %in% c("Long-term", "Long_term") ~ "Long-term (>5d)",
        TRUE ~ Band
      ),
      Band = factor(Band, levels = c("Total", "Short-term (1-5d)", "Long-term (>5d)"))
    )

  # 3. 그래프 그리기
  p_boot_dist <- ggplot(boot_df, aes(x = TCI, fill = Band)) +
    # 히스토그램 (부드럽게)
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 40, alpha = 0.5, color = "white") +
    # 밀도 곡선 (진하게)
    geom_density(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8) +

    # 평균선 (Mean) - 검은 실선
    geom_vline(data = ci_plot_data, aes(xintercept = Mean),
               linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    # 95% 신뢰구간 (Lower/Upper) - 회색 점선
    geom_vline(data = ci_plot_data, aes(xintercept = CI_Lower),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
    geom_vline(data = ci_plot_data, aes(xintercept = CI_Upper),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +

    # 패널 분할 (세로로 배치)
    facet_wrap(~Band, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +

    # [수정] 정확한 색상 적용 (colors_freq)
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_freq) +

    labs(
      title = "Bootstrap Distribution of TCI",
      subtitle = paste("Based on", boot_tci$n_success, "successful replications (95% CI)"),
      x = "TCI (%)",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") # Facet으로 구분되므로 범례 숨김

  print(p_boot_dist)
  ggsave("Figure8_Bootstrap_Distribution.png", p_boot_dist,
         width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

# Sensitivity Analysis

```{r sensitivity_analysis}
# Parameter Sensitivity Analysis

cat("Running sensitivity analysis...\n")

# Kappa sensitivity
kappa_values <- c(0.96, 0.97, 0.98, 0.99)
kappa_results <- list()

for (kappa in kappa_values) {
  cat("   Testing kappa =", kappa, "...\n")

  tryCatch({
    dca_test <- ConnectednessApproach(
      core_data_zoo,
      model = "TVP-VAR",
      connectedness = "Frequency",
      nlag = 1,
      VAR_config = list(TVPVAR = list(kappa1 = kappa, kappa2 = kappa, prior = "BayesPrior")),
      Connectedness_config = list(
        FrequencyConnectedness = list(partition = partition_freq, generalized = TRUE, scenario = "ABS")
      )
    )

    tci_means <- colMeans(dca_test$TCI, na.rm = TRUE)
    kappa_results[[as.character(kappa)]] <- tibble(
      Kappa = kappa,
      Total = tci_means[1],
      Short_term = tci_means[2],
      Long_term = tci_means[3],
      Long_Share = tci_means[3] / tci_means[1] * 100  # 추가!
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("     Error:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

kappa_sensitivity <- bind_rows(kappa_results)

# Frequency cutoff sensitivity
cutoff_values <- c(3, 5, 7, 10)
cutoff_results <- list()

for (cutoff in cutoff_values) {
  cat("   Testing cutoff =", cutoff, "days...\n")

  partition_test <- c(pi + 0.00001, pi/cutoff, 0)

  tryCatch({
    dca_test <- ConnectednessApproach(
      core_data_zoo,
      model = "TVP-VAR",
      connectedness = "Frequency",
      nlag = 1,
      VAR_config = list(TVPVAR = list(kappa1 = 0.99, kappa2 = 0.99, prior = "BayesPrior")),
      Connectedness_config = list(
        FrequencyConnectedness = list(partition = partition_test, generalized = TRUE, scenario = "ABS")
      )
    )

    tci_means <- colMeans(dca_test$TCI, na.rm = TRUE)
    cutoff_results[[as.character(cutoff)]] <- tibble(
      Cutoff_Days = cutoff,
      Total = tci_means[1],
      Short_term = tci_means[2],
      Long_term = tci_means[3],
      Long_Share = tci_means[3] / tci_means[1] * 100
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("     Error:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

cutoff_sensitivity <- bind_rows(cutoff_results)

# Display results
if (nrow(kappa_sensitivity) > 0) {
  kappa_sensitivity %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2))) %>%
    pretty_table(title = "Table 17: Forgetting Factor (κ) Sensitivity")

  write.csv(kappa_sensitivity, "Table17_Kappa_Sensitivity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

if (nrow(cutoff_sensitivity) > 0) {
  cutoff_sensitivity %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2))) %>%
    pretty_table(title = "Table 18: Frequency Cutoff Sensitivity")

  write.csv(cutoff_sensitivity, "Table18_Cutoff_Sensitivity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\nSensitivity analysis complete\n")
```

# Network Visualization

```{r network_viz, fig.height=10}
# Network Visualization (FINAL FIXED - NO TITLE, BIG LEGEND)

# 1. 색상 팔레트 정의
colors_net_nodes <- c(
  "Net Transmitter" = "#007B4B", # Primary Green
  "Net Receiver"    = "#E74C3C"  # Danger Red
)

colors_net_edges <- c(
  "Positive" = "#007B4B", # Green
  "Negative" = "#E74C3C"  # Red
)

# 2. 데이터 재구성
# (1) 엣지(Edge) 데이터
edge_data <- df_NPDC %>%
  filter(Frequency_Band == "Total") %>%
  group_by(From, To) %>%
  summarise(Avg_NPDC = mean(NPDC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(From != To) %>%
  mutate(
    sign = ifelse(Avg_NPDC > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    weight = abs(Avg_NPDC)
  ) %>%
  filter(weight > 0.1)

# (2) 노드(Node) 데이터
node_data <- df_NET %>%
  filter(Frequency_Band == "Total") %>%
  group_by(Asset) %>%
  summarise(Mean_NET = mean(NET, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Role = ifelse(Mean_NET > 0, "Net Transmitter", "Net Receiver"),
    name = Asset
  )

# 3. 그래프 생성 및 시각화
if (nrow(edge_data) > 0) {

  # igraph 객체 생성
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edge_data, vertices = node_data, directed = TRUE)

  # 시각화
  p_network <- ggraph(g, layout = "circle") + # 원형 레이아웃 유지

    # (1) 엣지 (화살표)
    geom_edge_arc(
      aes(edge_width = weight, edge_color = sign, edge_alpha = weight),
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(6, "mm"), type = "closed"), # 화살표 약간 키움
      start_cap = circle(12, "mm"), # 간격 더 벌림
      end_cap = circle(12, "mm"),
      curvature = 0.3
    ) +

    # (2) 노드 (점)
    geom_node_point(
      aes(size = abs(Mean_NET), color = Role),
      alpha = 1.0
    ) +

    # (3) 노드 라벨
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7,          # 라벨 크기 확대
      color = "black",
      nudge_y = 0.0
    ) +

    # 색상 및 크기 설정
    scale_edge_color_manual(values = colors_net_edges) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_net_nodes) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(12, 25), guide = "none") +
    scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(1, 4), guide = "none") +
    scale_edge_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.5, 0.9), guide = "none") +

    # 레이아웃 설정
    labs(
      title = NULL,    # 제목 제거
      subtitle = NULL, # 부제목 제거
      color = "Asset Role",
      edge_color = "Direction"
    ) +

    theme_void() +
    theme(
      # 범례 설정 (크기 확대)
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # 범례 제목 키움
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),                 # 범례 텍스트 키움
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),                     # 범례 심볼 크기 키움

      # 여백 설정
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )

  print(p_network)
  ggsave("Figure9_Network.png", p_network, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

} else {
  cat("No significant edges found to plot.\n")
}
```

## Hypothesis Results Summary

```{r hypothesis_summary}
# Hypothesis Testing Summary (Updated for Robust Tests)

# 가설 요약 테이블 생성
hypothesis_summary <- tibble(
  Hypothesis = c(
    "H1: Long-term TCI increased post-ETF",
    "H2: Short-term TCI decreased post-ETF",
    "H3: BTC role evolved (Receiver → Transmitter)",
    "H4: Safe-haven conditional on VIX < 30",
    "H5: Dynamic hedging outperforms static"
  ),
  Status = c(
    # [수정] Robust Test 결과 변수(h1)와 내부 구조($p)에 맞게 변경
    ifelse(exists("h1") && h1$p < 0.05, "Supported", "○ Not Supported"),

    # [수정] Robust Test 결과 변수(h2)와 내부 구조($p)에 맞게 변경
    ifelse(exists("h2") && h2$p < 0.05, "Supported", "○ Not Supported"),

    # H3: 기존 Trend Test 유지 (Kendall's tau)
    ifelse(exists("trend_test") && trend_test$p.value < 0.05, "Supported", "○ Not Supported"),

    # H4: Safe Haven 분석 존재 여부 확인
    ifelse(exists("safe_haven_stats"), "Evidence Found", "○ Not Tested"),

    # H5: Ledoit-Wolf Test 유지
    ifelse(exists("lw_test1") && lw_test1$Significant, "Supported", "○ Not Supported")
  )
)

# 테이블 출력 (스타일링 적용)
hypothesis_summary %>%
  kbl(caption = "Summary of Hypothesis Testing Results") %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#2C3E50", color = "white") %>% # 헤더 스타일
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE,
              color = ifelse(grepl("", hypothesis_summary$Status), "#27AE60", "#95a5a6")) # Green vs Gray
```

```{r tvpvar_cov_to_hedge, fig.height=7}
# TEST: Extract TVP-VAR time-varying covariance (Q_t) -> Hedge Ratio

cat("Checking if dca_core already contains covariance slots...\n")
possible_cov_slots <- c("Sigma", "Sigma_t", "Q", "Q_t", "H", "H_t", "cov", "cov_t")
found_slots <- intersect(names(dca_core), possible_cov_slots)
cat("   Found in dca_core:", ifelse(length(found_slots)==0, "NONE", paste(found_slots, collapse=", ")), "\n\n")

# 1) Run TVPVAR separately on BTC-SPY (since dca_core has only connectedness outputs)
stopifnot(all(c("BTC","SPY") %in% colnames(core_data_zoo)))

pair_data <- core_data_zoo[, c("BTC","SPY")]

cat("Running TVPVAR on BTC-SPY to extract Q_t...\n")
tvp_fit <- ConnectednessApproach:::TVPVAR(
  pair_data,
  configuration = list(
    l    = c(0.99, 0.99),  # 여기!
    nlag = 1,
    prior = NULL           # 일단 NULL로 (아래 참고)
  )
)

# 2) Robustly locate the time-varying covariance array inside tvp_fit
get_cov_array <- function(obj) {
  # common candidates used in ConnectednessApproach TVPVAR output
  candidates <- c("Q_t", "Qt", "Q", "H_t", "Ht", "H", "Sigma_t", "Sigma")
  for (nm in candidates) {
    if (!is.null(obj[[nm]])) return(obj[[nm]])
  }
  # fallback: search for first 3D numeric array [k x k x T]
  for (nm in names(obj)) {
    x <- obj[[nm]]
    if (is.numeric(x) && length(dim(x)) == 3 && dim(x)[1] == dim(x)[2]) return(x)
  }
  stop("Could not find a [k x k x T] covariance array in tvp_fit.")
}

Q_t <- get_cov_array(tvp_fit)

# 3) Ensure dimnames exist (assets + dates)
k <- dim(Q_t)[1]
Tn <- dim(Q_t)[3]

if (is.null(dimnames(Q_t))) dimnames(Q_t) <- vector("list", 3)

# row/col names
if (is.null(dimnames(Q_t)[[1]]) || is.null(dimnames(Q_t)[[2]])) {
  dimnames(Q_t)[[1]] <- colnames(pair_data)
  dimnames(Q_t)[[2]] <- colnames(pair_data)
}

# time names (dates)
# TVPVAR outputs sometimes omit date names, so we map to index(pair_data)
if (is.null(dimnames(Q_t)[[3]])) {
  dimnames(Q_t)[[3]] <- as.character(index(pair_data))[seq_len(Tn)]
}

# 4) Compute hedge ratio: beta*_t = Cov(BTC,SPY)/Var(SPY)
hr_vec <- as.numeric(Q_t["BTC","SPY",] / Q_t["SPY","SPY",])

df_hr_tvp <- tibble(
  Date = as.Date(dimnames(Q_t)[[3]]),
  hedge_ratio_tvp = hr_vec
) %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("\nHedge ratio summary (TVPVAR-Q_t based):\n")
print(summary(df_hr_tvp$hedge_ratio_tvp))

# Save
write.csv(df_hr_tvp, "TVPVAR_Qt_HedgeRatio_BTC_SPY.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: TVPVAR_Qt_HedgeRatio_BTC_SPY.csv\n")

# 5) Quick visualization
p_hr <- ggplot(df_hr_tvp, aes(x = Date, y = hedge_ratio_tvp)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9, color = colors_primary["primary"]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "TVP-VAR(Q_t)-Based Dynamic Hedge Ratio: BTC hedged with SPY",
    subtitle = "β*_t = Cov(BTC,SPY)_t / Var(SPY)_t",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Hedge Ratio"
  )

print(p_hr)
ggsave("Figure_HR_TVPVAR_Qt.png", p_hr, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("Saved: Figure_HR_TVPVAR_Qt.png\n")
```
```{r tvpvar_qt_hedge_ratio_test, fig.height=6}
# TVP-VAR (pair) -> Q_t -> Hedge Ratio

stopifnot(is(pair_data, "zoo"))
stopifnot(ncol(pair_data) == 2)

# 1) Fit TVPVAR and extract Q_t
tvp_fit <- ConnectednessApproach:::TVPVAR(
  pair_data,
  configuration = list(
    l    = c(0.99, 0.99), # forgetting factors
    nlag = 1,
    prior = NULL          # change to prior_obj if you build BayesPrior object
  )
)

Q_t <- tvp_fit$Q_t  # [2 x 2 x T] time-varying covariance matrix
print(dim(Q_t))
print(dimnames(Q_t)[[1]])

# 2) Hedge ratio: beta*_t = Cov(BTC,SPY)/Var(SPY)
asset_x <- colnames(pair_data)[1]  # "BTC"
asset_y <- colnames(pair_data)[2]  # "SPY"

hedge_ratio <- Q_t[asset_x, asset_y, ] / Q_t[asset_y, asset_y, ]

# 3) Wrap as zoo aligned with dates
dates <- as.Date(dimnames(Q_t)[[3]])
hr_zoo <- zoo::zoo(as.numeric(hedge_ratio), order.by = dates)

# 4) Quick sanity checks
cat("NA count:", sum(is.na(hr_zoo)), "\n")
cat("Range:", range(hr_zoo, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# 5) Plot

ggplot(hr_df, aes(x = Date, y = HedgeRatio)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Time-Varying Hedge Ratio from TVP-VAR Q_t",
    subtitle = paste0(asset_x, " hedged with ", asset_y, ":  β*_t = Cov/Var"),
    x = "Date", y = "Hedge Ratio"
  ) +

str(dca_core)
dim(dca_core$TCI)
dim(dca_core$NET)

dim(tvp_fit$Q_t)

range(as.numeric(tvp_fit$Q_t[1,2,] / tvp_fit$Q_t[2,2,]), na.rm=TRUE)

# TVP-VAR (ConnectednessApproach:::TVPVAR)로 Q_t 추출
# Hedge Ratio: beta*_t = Cov(BTC,SPY)_t / Var(SPY)_t

# 0) Pair data 준비 (이미 pair_data가 있으면 이 블록은 생략 가능)
pair_data <- core_data_zoo[, c("BTC","SPY")]
stopifnot(is.zoo(pair_data), ncol(pair_data)==2)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(coredata(pair_data)))==0, sum(is.infinite(coredata(pair_data)))==0)

# 1) TVPVAR 실행 (에러 방지: configuration$l 필수)
tvp_fit <- tryCatch({
  ConnectednessApproach:::TVPVAR(
    pair_data,
    configuration = list(
      l    = c(0.99, 0.99),  # 필수 (kappa1/kappa2가 아니라 l을 받음)
      nlag = 1,
      prior = NULL          # TVPVAR에서는 NULL 권장(문자열 "BayesPrior" 넣지 말기)
    )
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  stop("TVPVAR failed: ", e$message)
})

Q_t <- tvp_fit$Q_t
dates_q <- as.Date(dimnames(Q_t)[[3]])

# 2) Q_t에서 공분산/분산/헤지비율 추출
df_qhedge <- tibble::tibble(
  Date    = dates_q,
  Cov_BS  = as.numeric(Q_t["BTC","SPY",]),
  Var_S   = as.numeric(Q_t["SPY","SPY",]),
  Var_B   = as.numeric(Q_t["BTC","BTC",])
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HedgeRatio_TVP = dplyr::if_else(Var_S > 0, Cov_BS / Var_S, NA_real_),
    Corr_TVP = dplyr::if_else(Var_B > 0 & Var_S > 0, Cov_BS / sqrt(Var_B * Var_S), NA_real_)
  )

# sanity check (네가 이미 확인한 범위랑 일치해야 정상)
print(summary(df_qhedge$HedgeRatio_TVP))
print(range(df_qhedge$HedgeRatio_TVP, na.rm=TRUE))

# 3) 시각화: Hedge Ratio & TVP correlation
p_hr_tvp <- ggplot(df_qhedge, aes(x = Date, y = HedgeRatio_TVP)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "TVP-VAR Hedge Ratio (BTC hedged by SPY)",
       subtitle = expression(beta[t]^"*" == Cov(BTC,SPY)[t] / Var(SPY)[t]),
       x = "Date", y = "Hedge Ratio") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_corr_tvp <- ggplot(df_qhedge, aes(x = Date, y = Corr_TVP)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "TVP-VAR Implied Correlation (BTC, SPY)",
       x = "Date", y = "Correlation") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_hr_tvp)
print(p_corr_tvp)

ggsave("Figure_TVP_HedgeRatio.png", p_hr_tvp, width=14, height=6, dpi=300, bg="white")
ggsave("Figure_TVP_Corr.png", p_corr_tvp, width=14, height=6, dpi=300, bg="white")

# 1) TVPVAR 실행 (에러 방지: configuration$l 필수)
tvp_fit <- tryCatch({
  ConnectednessApproach:::TVPVAR(
    pair_data,
    configuration = list(
      l    = c(0.99, 0.99),  # 필수 (kappa1/kappa2가 아니라 l을 받음)
      nlag = 1,
      prior = NULL          # TVPVAR에서는 NULL 권장(문자열 "BayesPrior" 넣지 말기)
    )
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  stop("TVPVAR failed: ", e$message)
})

Q_t <- tvp_fit$Q_t
dates_q <- as.Date(dimnames(Q_t)[[3]])

# 2) Q_t에서 공분산/분산/헤지비율 추출
```

```{r etf_hypothesis_revised}
# ETF Approval Impact Test - REVISED
# Key Changes:
# 1. H1 redefined as "no increase" (one-sided test)
# 2. TOST equivalence test added for economic significance
# 3. Pipeline bootstrap for ETF effect CI

etf_date <- as.Date("2024-01-10")

if (etf_date >= min(df_TCI$Date) && etf_date <= max(df_TCI$Date)) {

  # 데이터 준비
  df_test <- df_TCI %>%
    mutate(Post_ETF_Dummy = ifelse(Date >= etf_date, 1, 0))

  pre_etf <- df_test %>% filter(Post_ETF_Dummy == 0)
  post_etf <- df_test %>% filter(Post_ETF_Dummy == 1)

  cat("ETF Analysis Sample Sizes:\n")
  cat("   Pre-ETF:", nrow(pre_etf), "observations\n")
  cat("   Post-ETF:", nrow(post_etf), "observations\n\n")

  # HAC Robust Test Function (Updated)
  run_robust_test <- function(y_col, alternative = "two.sided") {
    formula <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Post_ETF_Dummy"))
    model <- lm(formula, data = df_test)
    nw_vcov <- sandwich::NeweyWest(model,
                                   lag = floor(4 * (nrow(df_test)/100)^(2/9)),
                                   prewhite = FALSE, adjust = TRUE)
    test_res <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov = nw_vcov)

    beta <- test_res["Post_ETF_Dummy", "Estimate"]
    se <- test_res["Post_ETF_Dummy", "Std. Error"]
    t_stat <- test_res["Post_ETF_Dummy", "t value"]
    p_val_two_sided <- test_res["Post_ETF_Dummy", "Pr(>|t|)"]

    # One-sided p-value conversion
    if (alternative == "greater") {
      p_val <- ifelse(t_stat > 0, p_val_two_sided / 2, 1 - p_val_two_sided / 2)
    } else if (alternative == "less") {
      p_val <- ifelse(t_stat < 0, p_val_two_sided / 2, 1 - p_val_two_sided / 2)
    } else {
      p_val <- p_val_two_sided
    }

    return(list(stat = t_stat, p = p_val, diff = beta, se = se,
                p_two = p_val_two_sided))
  }

  # HYPOTHESIS TESTS - REVISED
  cat("Running Revised Hypothesis Tests...\n\n")

  # H1 (REVISED): Long-term connectedness does NOT increase post-ETF
  # H0: Δ ≥ 0 (increase)  vs  H1: Δ < 0 (no increase / decrease)
  # One-sided test: alternative = "less"
  h1 <- run_robust_test("Long_term", alternative = "less")

  # H2: Short-term decreased (One-sided < 0)
  h2 <- run_robust_test("Short_term", alternative = "less")

  # Total: Two-sided
  h3 <- run_robust_test("Total", alternative = "two.sided")

  # TOST EQUIVALENCE TEST FOR LONG-TERM TCI
  cat("Running TOST Equivalence Test for Long-term TCI...\n")

  # Define SESOI (Smallest Effect Size of Interest)
  # Based on Short-term effect magnitude as reference
  short_term_effect <- abs(h2$diff)
  SESOI <- max(0.5, short_term_effect * 0.2)  # 0.5pp or 20% of short-term effect

  cat("   SESOI (equivalence bounds): ±", round(SESOI, 3), "pp\n")

  # Manual TOST implementation
  # H0: |Δ| ≥ SESOI  vs  H1: |Δ| < SESOI (equivalent)
  t_lower <- (h1$diff - (-SESOI)) / h1$se
  t_upper <- (h1$diff - SESOI) / h1$se
  df_tost <- nrow(df_test) - 2

  p_lower <- pt(t_lower, df_tost, lower.tail = FALSE)  # Test against -SESOI
  p_upper <- pt(t_upper, df_tost, lower.tail = TRUE)   # Test against +SESOI
  p_tost <- max(p_lower, p_upper)

  equivalence_result <- ifelse(p_tost < 0.05, "EQUIVALENT ", "Not Equivalent")

  cat("   TOST p-value:", round(p_tost, 4), "\n")
  cat("   Result:", equivalence_result, "\n\n")

  # SUMMARY TABLE - REVISED
  etf_test_results <- tibble(
    Hypothesis = c(
      "H1: Long-term TCI no increase",
      "H2: Short-term TCI ↓ post-ETF",
      "Total TCI change"
    ),
    Pre_ETF_Mean = c(
      mean(pre_etf$Long_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(pre_etf$Short_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(pre_etf$Total, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    Post_ETF_Mean = c(
      mean(post_etf$Long_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(post_etf$Short_term, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(post_etf$Total, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    Difference = c(h1$diff, h2$diff, h3$diff),
    Robust_t = c(h1$stat, h2$stat, h3$stat),
    p_value = c(h1$p, h2$p, h3$p),
    Test_Type = c("One-sided (< 0)", "One-sided (< 0)", "Two-sided"),
    Result = c(
      ifelse(h1$p < 0.05, "SUPPORTED ", "Not Supported"),
      ifelse(h2$p < 0.05, "SUPPORTED ", "Not Supported"),
      ifelse(h3$p < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant")
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

  etf_test_results %>%
    pretty_table(title = "Table 7: ETF Impact Hypothesis Tests (Revised)")

  # TOST Result Table
  tost_result <- tibble(
    Variable = "Long-term TCI",
    Effect = round(h1$diff, 3),
    SESOI = paste0("±", round(SESOI, 3)),
    TOST_p = round(p_tost, 4),
    Conclusion = equivalence_result,
    Interpretation = "Change is economically negligible"
  )

  tost_result %>%
    pretty_table(title = "Table 7b: TOST Equivalence Test for Economic Significance")

  write.csv(etf_test_results, "Table7_ETF_Hypothesis_Tests_Revised.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(tost_result, "Table7b_TOST_Equivalence.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  # Store for later use
  etf_test_results_final <- etf_test_results

} else {
  cat("ETF date is outside sample.\n")
}

```

```{r placebo_test}
# PLACEBO TEST: Robustness for ETF Causal Identification
# Tests whether similar "ETF effects" appear at arbitrary dates
# If placebo dates show significant effects, causal interpretation is weakened

cat("Running Placebo Tests...\n\n")

# Define placebo dates (1 year and 6 months before actual ETF)
placebo_dates <- c(
  "2023-01-11",  # 1 year before
  "2023-07-10"   # 6 months before
)
placebo_dates <- as.Date(placebo_dates)

# Function to run ETF-style analysis at any date
run_placebo_analysis <- function(event_date, df_tci) {

  if (event_date < min(df_tci$Date) + 60 || event_date > max(df_tci$Date) - 60) {
    return(NULL)  # Not enough data before/after
  }

  df_temp <- df_tci %>%
    mutate(Post_Event = ifelse(Date >= event_date, 1, 0))

  results <- map_dfr(c("Total", "Short_term", "Long_term"), function(y_col) {
    formula <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Post_Event"))
    model <- lm(formula, data = df_temp)
    nw_vcov <- sandwich::NeweyWest(model,
                                   lag = floor(4 * (nrow(df_temp)/100)^(2/9)),
                                   prewhite = FALSE, adjust = TRUE)
    test_res <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov = nw_vcov)

    tibble(
      Variable = y_col,
      Beta = test_res["Post_Event", "Estimate"],
      SE = test_res["Post_Event", "Std. Error"],
      t_stat = test_res["Post_Event", "t value"],
      p_value = test_res["Post_Event", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  })

  results$Event_Date <- event_date
  return(results)
}

# Run placebo tests
placebo_results <- bind_rows(
  # Actual ETF
  run_placebo_analysis(etf_date, df_TCI) %>%
    mutate(Event_Type = "Actual ETF (2024-01-10)"),

  # Placebo 1
  run_placebo_analysis(placebo_dates[1], df_TCI) %>%
    mutate(Event_Type = "Placebo 1 (2023-01-11)"),

  # Placebo 2
  run_placebo_analysis(placebo_dates[2], df_TCI) %>%
    mutate(Event_Type = "Placebo 2 (2023-07-10)")
)

# Format results
placebo_summary <- placebo_results %>%
  select(Event_Type, Variable, Beta, t_stat, p_value) %>%
  mutate(
    Significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Yes*", "No"),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Variable, Event_Type)

placebo_summary %>%
  pretty_table(title = "Table 7c: Placebo Test Results")

write.csv(placebo_summary, "Table7c_Placebo_Tests.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Visualization: Placebo Comparison
placebo_plot_data <- placebo_results %>%
  filter(Variable == "Short_term") %>%
  mutate(
    Event_Type = factor(Event_Type, levels = c("Placebo 1 (2023-01-11)",
                                                "Placebo 2 (2023-07-10)",
                                                "Actual ETF (2024-01-10)")),
    CI_lower = Beta - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_upper = Beta + 1.96 * SE,
    Is_Actual = ifelse(grepl("Actual", Event_Type), "Actual", "Placebo")
  )

p_placebo <- ggplot(placebo_plot_data, aes(x = Event_Type, y = Beta, fill = Is_Actual)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Actual" = "#007B4B", "Placebo" = "#999999")) +
  labs(
    title = "Placebo Test: Short-term TCI Effect",
    subtitle = "Actual ETF vs Placebo Dates (95% CI)",
    x = "",
    y = "Effect (pp)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

print(p_placebo)
ggsave("Figure_Placebo_Test.png", p_placebo, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("\nPlacebo Analysis Complete\n")
cat("   Interpretation: If only actual ETF date shows significant effect,\n")
cat("   causal interpretation is strengthened.\n")
```
